stories.title: Jahmyr Gibbs drops 51.2 on Thanksgiving, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix is up 111.36 to 50.74 with Ja'Marr Chase still to play
stories.dek: 205 rushing yards, three touchdowns, and Catfan94 still left Rome Odunze's game-winner on the bench. 10‑1 doesn't care.
body: Bears 39, Lions 35, and the best player on the field lost. Jahmyr Gibbs ran 21 times for 205 yards and three touchdowns and caught five more for 47. That's 51.2 fantasy points, which is more than Dude, Your Getting a Dell scored in Week 8 by itself. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix leads Bourbon Lover 111.36 to 50.74 with only Ja'Marr Chase and Brock Bowers left.

Here's the part that makes me want to throw a plate: Rome Odunze caught the game-winning touchdown with three seconds left and scored 25.2 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench. Catfan94 is so stacked the bench outscored half the league's Thanksgiving. Josh Allen threw for 81 yards and two picks in the rain in Buffalo and scored 5.54, and it didn't matter at all.

Bourbon Lover got 29.54 from Dak Prescott and 15.4 from Sam LaPorta, and Dallas blew a 31-10 lead to lose. paknight12 has Courtland Sutton and Rico Dowdle going in Pittsburgh today, plus three Sunday starters, and needs about 98 points from five guys. I've got the line at 38.0.

Over in Catfan94’s Farm Team vs Kraft for Cash, the tie from Wednesday is gone: DeVonta Smith caught 11 for 200 and two touchdowns (41.5), D'Andre Swift added 28.7, Amon-Ra St. Brown 21.6, and it's 106.80 to 50.50. That's a 46-point line now. Joe Milton III threw for 331 and three scores and sat on that bench for 38.74. More on that below.

stories.title: TJohn91 traded Kimani Vidal and a fourth for Isiah Pacheco, who's on IR, on Thanksgiving morning, during a playoff race
stories.dek: The Champ is 6‑5 and trailing Hold My DK. Catfan94 gets another running back, because of course he does.
body: The only trade of the week landed Thursday morning: TJohn91 sent Kimani Vidal and a 2027 fourth-round pick (originally Hold My DK's) to Catfan94 for Isiah Pacheco. Pacheco is on Detroit's IR after back surgery in September. The report at the time said about 12 weeks and an early-December return.

So here's the read. The Champ is 6‑5, holds the tiebreaker on Jefferson’s Reserve for the last spot, and Josh Jacobs and TreVeyon Henderson are both unavailable. TJohn91 is betting Pacheco is back for the fantasy playoffs. If he is, it's a two-time champ buying a running back for the part of the season that matters. If he isn't, it's a guy who traded a healthy 25-year-old for a roster spot with a red tag on it.

From the other side: Catfan94 is 10‑1 with 1860.84 points and now has Kimani Vidal on top of Gibbs, Barkley, Emmett Johnson, De'Von Achane, Rachaad White, Tank Bigsby and Ollie Gordon II. Nobody needed this less. He did it anyway, and picked up a fourth. That's how you get to 1860.

Dynasty angle: Pacheco is 27 and Vidal is 25. Both are backups on their real teams right now. The Champ is playing for this year, which is what you do when you've won the last two. Hold My DK, who already sold its 2027 picks through round four, is now watching its old fourth get passed around like a joint.

stories.title: Joe Milton III threw for 331 yards and three touchdowns. Catfan94’s Farm Team had him on the bench.
stories.dek: 38.74 points sitting behind Deshaun Watson. jrsmith1391 is winning by 56 anyway.
body: Joe Milton III went 21 for 31, 331 yards, three touchdowns and a pick in Dallas, and scored 38.74 on the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench. Deshaun Watson starts at superflex and plays Sunday. That's the number Watson has to beat: 38.74. Watson's best week this year is 26.72.

In fairness to jrsmith1391, the season says this was close. Milton scored 14.16 in Week 9 and 5.34 in Week 11. Watson has scored 21.38 and 18.22 in two of his last five. It wasn't crazy. It just cost 38.74 points in a game Catfan94’s Farm Team leads by 56.30, so it costs nothing. That's the 8‑3 life.

I Chase Brown Kids finally caught one: Javonte Williams scored 33.3 in Dallas, and I Chase Brown Kids leads Jefferson’s Reserve 33.30 to 0.00. Blake Corum's 31.5 is still on that bench from Wednesday, so ZachCarroll09 could be up 64.80 and isn't. I've flipped that line: I Chase Brown Kids by 17.0.

And on my bench: Makai Lemon scored 13.6 for Philadelphia Thursday. My starting receivers are Parker Washington, Jakobi Meyers (Questionable) and Denzel Boston (Questionable). That's Konata Mumpfield's 10.9 Wednesday and Lemon's 13.6 Thursday on the pine. 24.5 points. StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has 0.00.

stories.title: I've left 28.7 points on my bench and scored zero, and I'm still the favorite against the 0‑11 team
stories.dek: StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has nine starters left. Dude, Your Getting a Dell has 2.40 from Dallas Goedert.
body: Running tally for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte this week: Kaleb Johnson 4.2 on the taxi squad, Konata Mumpfield 10.9 on the bench, Makai Lemon 13.6 on the bench. That's 28.7 points not counting. In the lineup: 0.00. Every one of my starters plays Sunday, which I'm told is a strategy.

Br0phy is up 2.40 to 0.00 thanks to Dallas Goedert. That's a lead for Dude, Your Getting a Dell, and I'm the one handing it over. Season PPG says StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte by 32.17 with Josh Johnson at quarterback. I trimmed it to 28.0 because Meyers and Boston are both Questionable and because I know who sets my lineup.

I'm 3‑8 with 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, so I'll keep saying it: the picks are the plan. The plan just doesn't include setting a lineup. Black Friday, everybody. My team's been on sale all year.

columns.dek: Hugh G. Rection has had four Dunkin' coolattas and some thoughts on I Chase Brown Kids.
body: THIRTY-TWO CARRIES!! A HUNDRED EIGHTY-FOUR YARDS!! THIRTY-ONE POINT FIVE FANTASY POINTS!! AND ZachCarroll09 HAD HIM SITTING NEXT TO THE GATORADE!!

This guy started Weeks 6 through 10 and scored 14.5, 19.6, 14.3, 13.3 and 22.9. Then the Rams had a bye and he got DEMOTED. FOR WHAT. FOR RESTING. You know who else rests? Me. In this basement. Nobody benches ME.

And it's the SECOND WEEK IN A ROW. Last week Rashod Bateman scored 16.2 on the bench in a 10.38-point loss. I Chase Brown Kids is 4-7. FOUR AND SEVEN. You don't get to be 4‑7 AND leave 47.7 points on the pine in back-to-back weeks. PICK ONE.

Jefferson’s Reserve is a 1-point favorite and jmello16 doesn't have a single player in a Thanksgiving game. They didn't have to do ANYTHING. ZachCarroll09 did it for them. GOBBLE GOBBLE, YOU ABSOLUTE TURKEY!!

columns.title: TJohn91 traded for a running back on IR in the middle of a playoff race. I respect it. I don't like it.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya on The Champ, Isiah Pacheco, and buying for December.
body: Two titles in two years buys you a little benefit of the doubt. TJohn91 sent Kimani Vidal and a 2027 fourth to Catfan94 for Isiah Pacheco on Thanksgiving morning. Pacheco is on Detroit's IR after back surgery in September. The report back then said about 12 weeks. You do that math and you land on the fantasy playoffs.

Here's my problem. The Champ is 6‑5 and holds the last spot on a tiebreaker. Josh Jacobs is out, TreVeyon Henderson is on IR, A.J. Brown is Doubtful. You don't get to December by acquiring a guy who can't play until December. You get there by winning this week, and right now you're down 37.86 to 22.22 to a 10‑1 team.

When I played, the coaches who won were the ones who planned for January without forgetting about Sunday. TJohn91 has done that twice. Maybe this is the third time. But if Jefferson’s Reserve jumps him on points, nobody's going to remember the plan.
And Catfan94, a fourth-round pick and a 25-year-old back for nothing you needed. You're 10‑1. That's not a trade, that's a tax. Pay attention, everybody else.

columns.title: 5 Black Friday moves from Holden McGroin, who is currently in line at a Best Buy
columns.dek: Holden McGroin's advice for the rest of Week 12, typed on a demo laptop.
body: 1. jrsmith1391, Joe Milton III scored 38.74 on your bench. Bench him again Sunday. He's clearly better from the bench. You don't mess with a guy's routine.
2. ManicOrientals, Daniel Jones doesn't have an NFL team, and Kyler Murray is Questionable. Start both. If Sleeper says no, that's Sleeper's problem.
3. ZachCarroll09, Javonte Williams scored 33.3 and Blake Corum scored 31.5. One was in your lineup. To be fair to both, start neither next week. Fairness wins championships.
4. Bill_Buttlicker, you have 0.00 and you're losing to an 0‑11 team. Trade all 12 first-round picks to Br0phy for Dallas Goedert. He already has points. That's called buying what's working.
5. paknight12, Dallas blew a 21-point lead with your quarterback. Drop the Cowboys. I know you can't drop a team. Try harder.

columns.title: Jahmyr Gibbs averaged 9.8 yards a carry. My model says that's 2.4 points per minute of my Thanksgiving dinner.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot timed her meal and divided. Nobody asked her to.
body: Jahmyr Gibbs ran 21 times for 205 yards. That's 9.8 yards per carry, which my model rounds to 10, which is a first down every time, which means Detroit should have won by infinity. They lost 39-35. The model stands by the infinity.

Gibbs scored 51.2 for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. That's 30.3% of the team's season PPG of 169.17 in one guy on one holiday. If every LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix player scored like Gibbs, they'd score 460.8 a week. Bourbon Lover would need to be about four Bourbon Lovers to keep up. I'm told that's not how it works. I've told them it could be.

Meanwhile Catfan94’s Farm Team left 38.74 from Joe Milton III on the bench and still leads by 56.30. That means Catfan94’s Farm Team's bench is worth 68.8% of its lead. My model says a team's bench should never be worth more than 50% of its lead, so I've marked this matchup 'over-optimized.'

Wednesday's 15.50-15.50 tie did not hold. My previous projection was 139.50 to 139.50. Current score: 106.80 to 50.50. I'm calling that 76.6% correct, based on the Catfan94’s Farm Team side, which is the side I'm counting.

exits.t: Threw for 331 yards and three touchdowns on Thanksgiving, 38.74 points, on the Catfan94’s Farm Team bench while Deshaun Watson starts Sunday. Watson's best week this season is 26.72. Milton would like a manager who starts the guy who already scored.
Caught the game-winning touchdown with three seconds left on Thanksgiving and scored 25.2 on the LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix bench. Catfan94 doesn't need him, and Odunze has noticed.
Scored 13.6 Thursday on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench while two Questionable receivers start. The lineup has 0.00. He'd like to go somewhere his points count.

Ran for a career-high 184 yards Wednesday and scored 31.5 on the I Chase Brown Kids bench, after five straight double-digit starts before the Rams' bye. Watched Javonte Williams get the lineup spot and the credit.
Caught nine for 122 on Monday Night Football in Week 11, 19.2 on the OBJAY bench while Emeka Egbuka and Luther Burden III started. OBJAY lost by 105.56.
Scored 15.9 Thursday, the only Asian Jim starter to play so far, in a lineup with Daniel Jones at quarterback. Monangai would like teammates who are on NFL teams.

facts: TJohn91 has won both titles on Sleeper. He went 12-2 in 2024 and 10-4 in 2025, and is 28-11 all time.
Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts, the most in the league. JAY2913 is next with six.
Catfan94's 243.58 in Week 5 this year is the highest score in league history, and his 232.54 in Week 10 is second. Nobody else has topped 198.64.
Bill_Buttlicker went 3-11 in 2024 and 4-10 in 2025, scored 54.86 in 2024 Week 3, the third-lowest score in league history, and is 10-29 all time.
Br0phy's 39.26 in Week 8 this year is the lowest score in league history by 14.78 points. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0-11.
